title: The Bakery Before Dawn
transcript: This morning we visited a bakery that opens before most shops. I asked its owner, Nina Reed, why she starts work at three. 'The dough needs time to rise,' she said. 'Besides, the nurses from the night shift want fresh bread on their way home.' I asked whether the early start had been difficult. 'At first I went to bed too late,' Nina told me. 'Now I finish work by noon, so I can pick up my son from school.'

questions.prompt: What reason did Nina give for starting work at three?
options: Her flour arrives at that hour.
The ovens are cheaper to run then.
The dough needs time to rise.
questions.answer: The dough needs time to rise.
questions.explanation: 妮娜说面团需要时间发酵。

questions.prompt: Who buys fresh bread on the way home?
questions.explanation: 采访中提到上夜班的护士会在回家路上买新鲜面包。
